paragraphs: US President Donald Trump reported over 1.4 billion dollars in income from his family’s cryptocurrency ventures in 2025, according to his latest financial disclosure.
Digital assets now provide the majority of his income, as he benefits heavily from his administration’s crypto-friendly policies.

Trump’s company received nearly 800 million from a project co-founded with his sons. This total includes 520 million dollars from token sales and 250 million from selling business interests. Additionally, sales of the Trump memecoin generated 635 million, and marked a massive increase from the 57 million reported the previous year. Since his 2025 inauguration, the Trump family has earned an estimated 2.3 billion from digital currencies.

While a White House spokesperson denied any conflicts of interest, Trump’s traditional businesses also thrived. His golf courses and resorts brought in over 500 million, and showed the strongest growth at clubs where the president spends significant time.

paragraphs: US President Donald Trump made more than 1.4 billion dollars from digital currency projects in 2025. A new official financial report shows that most of his income now comes from these digital assets.

Trump and his sons started a crypto project called World Liberty Financial, which earned nearly 800 million. This money came from selling digital tokens and business shares. Trump also made 635 million from a special digital coin named after him. Since he returned to the White House, his family earned around 2.3 billion from digital money.

A spokesperson said there is no problem with his official work and business. At the same time, Trump’s businesses, like his golf clubs and beautiful resorts, did very well and brought in more than 500 million last year.

Trump and his sons have a business called World Liberty Financial. They sell digital coins. They make hundreds of millions of dollars. In 2025, Trump becomes president again.
